component.name: TokenFlow
component.summary: Local token usage analytics for Ollama and DeepSeek

description.p: TokenFlow is a local-first desktop companion for Ollama and DeepSeek users. It runs a loopback proxy in front of Ollama, records the token counts reported by the stream, and polls the DeepSeek balance API.
Usage history is stored in a local SQLite database, and the DeepSeek API key is kept in the operating system credential store. Telemetry never leaves the machine.

ul.li: Input, output, context, and cached-token metrics
Native tray and tray-anchored metrics panel
